subject.title: fix(github-copilot): reject unvalidated OAuth enterprise domain on refresh

question: Should unsupported persisted GitHub Copilot OAuth enterprise domains fail refresh immediately and require reauthentication, with no automatic rewrite or fallback?
rationale: Rejecting the origin closes the credential-egress vulnerability, but mandatory reauthentication intentionally changes upgrade and recovery behavior for affected legacy profiles.

options.title: Require Reauthentication
options.body: Reject unsupported persisted origins before any request and guide affected users to authenticate again.

options.title: Design Safe Migration
options.body: Define a security-reviewed migration that cannot silently repoint or expose bearer credentials before landing the fix.

recommendation.title: Require Reauthentication
recommendation.body: Reject unsupported persisted origins before any request and guide affected users to authenticate again.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current host allowlist policy that this PR extends into the persisted OAuth refresh boundary.
